mechanism_narrative: Elevated RESIDENTIAL mobility (t-0w: 12.3, t-1w: 13.7) combined with depressed TRANSIT (t-0w: -61.6) indicates population confinement and avoidance of public transport. As workplace mobility recovers toward baseline over the next four weeks, commuting routines and incidental retail visits will increase proportionally, lifting RETAIL_REC.

failure_condition: WORKPLACES mobility continues to decline or stagnates below -30 for two consecutive weeks, or RETAIL_REC declines despite WORKPLACES recovery above -25.

failure_condition: PARKS mobility rises above 0 while GROCERY_PHARM remains positive, and RETAIL_REC increases in the following week, indicating discretionary activity resumes despite essential shopping.

This crowding-out effect will continue to suppress RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks as consumers allocate time and risk tolerance to essentials first.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM remained positive across all four weeks
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM falls below -5 for two consecutive weeks while RETAIL_REC rises above the last 28-day mean, indicating essential-goods demand normalization and retail recovery.
